hypothesis: Treasury–Fed Accord 2.0 / financial-repression setup is a scenario to monitor, not an assumed current regime.

treasury_duration_supply.label: Treasury duration-supply pressure proxy
treasury_duration_supply.source: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data — Monthly Statement of the Public Debt, Table 1
treasury_duration_supply.interpretation: Stock-change composition proxy only. Falling fixed-duration share is supportive for lower private duration pressure; this is not true net issuance, DV01, WAM or buyback flow.

fed_reserve_support.label: Fed / reserve support
fed_reserve_support.source: Federal Reserve H.4.1 Data Download Program
fed_reserve_support.interpretation: SUPPORTIVE requires non-shrinking Fed assets and reserves. RESERVE_CUSHION allows Fed assets to shrink while reserve balances are non-shrinking.

market_yield_suppression.label: Market yield-suppression verdict
market_yield_suppression.treasury_real_yield_source: U.S. Treasury Daily Treasury Par Real Yield Curve Rates
market_yield_suppression.term_premium_source: Federal Reserve Board three-factor nominal term-structure model (staff research product)
market_yield_suppression.interpretation: CONFIRM requires both 10Y real yield and 10Y term premium to be non-rising over approximately 3 months. REJECT requires both to rise.

bond_read.note: Tactical nominal-bond price support and structural real bond value are intentionally separate.

guardrail: Research diagnostic only. No GMLI score, conviction points, automatic allocation weights or CORE/OVERLAY promotion. Treasury block is a stock-change proxy, not true issuance flow.
